Available commands:
Use /help <command> for focused details.

FILES
-
/ingest
  Description: Ingest file content into vector memory.
  Usage: /ingest <path> [description] [--lines=N]
  Arguments:
    - path [required]: File path to ingest.
    - description [optional]: Optional source description; remaining words are joined.
    - --lines=N [optional]: Maximum number of source lines to ingest.

/read
  Description: Read a file with smart detection.
  Usage: /read <path> [--lines=N]
  Arguments:
    - path [required]: File path to read.
    - --lines=N [optional]: Maximum number of lines to return.

MAINTENANCE
-
/lifecycle
  Description: Run or inspect memory lifecycle processing.
  Usage: /lifecycle [--execute] [--stats|--flush|--optimize]
  Arguments:
    - --execute [optional]: Apply lifecycle changes instead of a dry run.
    - mode [optional] (choices=--stats, --flush, --optimize): Inspect statistics, flush access data, or optimize lifecycle state.

/migrate
  Description: Migrate existing memories to lifecycle metadata.
  Usage: /migrate [--force|--execute|--stats]
  Arguments:
    - mode [optional] (choices=--force, --execute, --stats): Execute migration or report dry-run statistics.

/reorganize
  Description: Preview or explicitly execute coordinated memory reorganization.
  Usage: /reorganize [--execute] [--backup|--dedupe|--analyze|--prune|--synthesize|--verify] [--skip-synthesis] [--skip-verify] [--skip-lifecycle] [--force-reembed]
       /reorganize --recover <run-id> [--execute]
  Arguments:
    - --execute [optional]: Apply changes (exact flag required; a verified recovery bundle is always created first).
    - mode [optional] (choices=--backup, --dedupe, --analyze, --prune, --synthesize, --verify): Run one reorganization step instead of the full operation.
    - --skip-synthesis [optional]: Skip synthesis during a full run.
    - --skip-verify [optional]: Skip verification during a full run.
    - --skip-lifecycle [optional]: Skip lifecycle processing.
    - --force-reembed [optional]: Force eligible records to be re-embedded.
    - --recover <run-id> [optional]: Inspect a retained run; add exact --execute to restore its recorded verified bundle.

MEMORY
-
/compact
  Description: Manually trigger context compaction.
  Usage: /compact
  Arguments: none

/context
  Description: Show the assembled context payload.
  Usage: /context [--debug] [--file]
  Arguments:
    - --debug [optional]: Include detailed token diagnostics.
    - --file [optional]: Export the context to a file.

/debug
  Description: Show context assembly debug information.
  Usage: /debug
  Arguments: none

/debug-budget
  Description: Show token budget diagnostics.
  Usage: /debug-budget
  Arguments: none

/debug-retrieval
  Description: Show retrieval diagnostics for a query.
  Usage: /debug-retrieval <query>
  Arguments:
    - query [required]: Retrieval query; remaining words are joined.

/entities
  Description: List graph entities and relationships.
  Usage: /entities [nodes|name]
  Arguments:
    - nodes|name [optional]: Use 'nodes' for node details or provide an entity name to inspect.

/insights
  Description: List durable insights.
  Usage: /insights
  Arguments: none

/list-ingested
  Description: List ingested document memory records.
  Usage: /list-ingested
  Arguments: none

/memory
  Description: Show typed memory, transcript, session, and context statistics.
  Usage: /memory
  Arguments: none

/meta
  Description: List active meta insights with lifecycle and provenance metadata.
  Usage: /meta
  Arguments: none

/prompt
  Description: Show the full formatted prompt sent to the LLM.
  Usage: /prompt [--file]
  Arguments:
    - --file [optional]: Export the prompt to a file.

/reset
  Description: Reset one or more memory stores.
  Usage: /reset [graph|vector|episodic]
  Arguments:
    - store [optional] (choices=graph, vector, episodic): Memory store to reset; omit to reset every supported store.

/summaries
  Description: List turn summaries.
  Usage: /summaries
  Arguments: none

/timing
  Description: Show timing breakdown for the last turn.
  Usage: /timing
  Arguments: none

ORCHESTRATION
-
/agent
  Description: Show detailed agent information.
  Usage: /agent [name]
  Arguments:
    - name [optional]: Agent name; omit to inspect the active agent.

/agents
  Description: List available agents.
  Usage: /agents
  Arguments: none

/delegate
  Description: Delegate a task to another agent.
  Usage: /delegate <agent> <task>
  Arguments:
    - agent [required]: Target agent name.
    - task [required]: Task text; remaining words are joined.

/status
  Description: Show orchestrator status.
  Usage: /status
  Arguments: none

/switch
  Description: Switch active agent or show current agent status.
  Usage: /switch [agent]
  Arguments:
    - agent [optional]: Agent name; omit to show the active agent.

SECURITY
-
/security
  Description: Show security status.
  Usage: /security
  Arguments: none

/security-config
  Description: Update security configuration.
  Usage: /security-config <sensitivity|action|wrapping> <value>
  Arguments:
    - setting [required] (choices=sensitivity, action, wrapping): Security setting to update.
    - value [required]: Validated value for the selected security setting.

/security-test
  Description: Run local security sanitization tests.
  Usage: /security-test [instruction|delimiter|jailbreak|exfil|all]

  Description: Run the speech validation harness.

TOOLS
-
/tools
  Description: List registered runtime tools and optionally filter by category.
  Usage: /tools [category]
  Arguments:
    - category [optional]: Optional runtime tool category filter.

/export
  Description: Export persisted entries from the current session.

/export-prompts
  Description: Export persisted captured prompts and responses for one session.
  Usage: /export-prompts [session_id]
  Arguments:
    - session_id [optional]: Session identifier; omit for the current session.

/replay
  Description: Replay a transcript CSV.
  Usage: /replay <csv_path> [delay_seconds]
  Arguments:
    - csv_path [required]: Transcript CSV path.
    - delay_seconds [optional] (default=0): Delay between replayed user turns.

/sessions
  Description: List persisted transcript sessions with current and primed markers.
  Usage: /sessions
  Arguments: none

  Description: Show a persisted current or selected transcript, or export all sessions.

  Arguments:
    - target [optional] (default=current session): Persisted session identifier to show, or export for all non-archived sessions.

/workflow

    - name [optional]: Workflow name for run, or an optional approval/skip identifier.
    - key=value [optional]: Optional workflow inputs for the run action.
